title: Principal
description: A subject that can be authenticated and authorized. Humans and machines are the same shape on purpose: both resolve through one authorization decision.

id.description: Stable identifier owned by the principal store. Never the issuer's subject; issuers change, this does not.

kind.description: Discriminator for audit and policy. NOT a proxy for privilege — privilege comes from roles.

issuer.description: The trusted issuer that authenticated this subject. Multi-issuer by design: the two Clerk tenants are different products with different audiences and stay separate.

subject.description: The issuer's subject claim (Clerk `sub`). Unique within an issuer, not across issuers.

roles.description: Named bundles of scopes. A principal's effective scopes are the union across its roles.

status.description: A suspended principal fails authorization for every scope, including scopes its roles grant.
